rows.title: Job form: browser Back and in-app links discard the typed input with no warning
rows.summary: Now: main.jsx mounts a data router (createHashRouter + RouterProvider), so the job form can block navigation. A changed job form asks 'Discard your changes?' (Keep editing / Discard) on browser Back and on every in-app link, as it already did on Cancel and the back arrow. Discard clears the sessionStorage draft and continues; Keep editing stays on the form. Save, Add Job and a confirmed Cancel set a 'leaving' flag before they navigate, so they do not ask again. A second Back pressed while the question is up asks nothing more (be9b7d7), so no question is left over on the next page. The hash history is the same, so location.key is still 'default' where useBackOrHome and useScrollMemory expect it.
rows.product_call: Guard every way out of a changed job form inside the app. Typing a new #/ address in the browser bar is not blockable by React Router; the sessionStorage draft still restores what was typed.
rows.remaining: Address-bar navigation is not guarded (see product_call); acceptable.

rows.title: Overview click-to-edit input is hand-rolled, not the kit box (job/Field.jsx)
rows.summary: Now: an opened Overview value in Field.jsx is the kit's input box, placed in its row after the field's icon, instead of a hand-rolled input.
rows.product_call: Use the kit box for consistency with the rest of the app.

rows.title: JobForm's 'Job not found' is a bare text link, not the EmptyState
rows.summary: Now: the edit page for a missing job shows the same 'Job not found' state as the job page (JobDetail.jsx), instead of a bare text link.
rows.product_call: Match the job page's not-found state.

rows.title: Quick-search results have no max height on short screens
rows.summary: Now: the TopBar quick-search results have a max height that fits the window (following the Dialog.jsx pattern) and scroll inside; the arrow keys keep the highlighted result in view. Hovering a result highlights it but no longer scrolls the list (a2f87a0); only the arrow keys and typing do.
rows.product_call: Scroll inside the list rather than past the screen.

rows.title: Projects table's Name cell cannot truncate
rows.summary: Now: a long project name in the Boards Projects table ends in an ellipsis at every width, not only on a phone. The Name column is the only one without a fixed width, so it still takes the remaining space. 103-r4-dph-08 was updated to expect truncation at every width (the new intended behaviour); it still checks the rule is not tied to one breakpoint.

rows.title: Pipeline 'Close as:' row does not wrap on a narrow phone
rows.summary: Now: an on-hold job's 'Close as:' row in the Pipeline wraps between its pills on a narrow phone instead of running past the edge.
rows.remaining: The pills are about 26 px tall (a11y target size, deferred; see a11yNoted).

rows.title: A long issue summary in the List (ProjectList.jsx) does not end in an ellipsis on wider screens
rows.summary: Now: a long issue summary in the Boards List ends in an ellipsis at every width. Summary is the only column without a fixed width, so it keeps the remaining space. 103-r4-dph-09 was updated to expect truncation at every width (intended behaviour), still checking the rule is not breakpoint-limited.
rows.product_call: Ellipsis at every width, same as the Projects Name cell.

rows.title: An open Overview field loses what is being typed when the job changes in another tab
rows.summary: Now: Field.jsx's draft follows the job only while the field is closed, so an open Overview field keeps what is being typed when the job is changed in another tab. An untouched open field writes nothing, and a blank company or role that the Overview refuses is reset when the field closes. 811a282's subject says R5-JOB-06, but it is this row; c299537 renamed the test file and comments only.
rows.product_call: Keep the user's in-progress input over a remote update.
